where_you_reach_twicc_from_your_devices_: Where you reach TwiCC from your devices — used to build links back to your sessions (e.g. in notifications). Leave empty to omit those links.
turns_off_animations_glass_blur_and_othe: Turns off animations, glass blur and other costly effects. Useful on a slower device. Only applies to this device.
keep_the_icon_bar_visible_when_the_sideb: Keep the icon bar visible when the sidebar is closed
anonymous_usage_statistics_counters_only: Anonymous usage statistics — counters only, never content, messages, titles or paths.
disabling_a_provider_stops_all_of_its_ba: Disabling a provider stops all of its background tasks, prevents creating new sessions or renaming existing ones, and hides its settings section. Existing sessions remain readable.
dedicated_share_host_a_hostname_distinct: Dedicated share host — a hostname distinct from this app, pointing at the same port (e.g. a second tunnel hostname). Required to create share links; a different port on the same hostname is not enough. Leave empty to disable sharing.
allows_agents_to_create_session_shares_w: Allows agents to create session shares whose target belongs to their own spawn subtree, and to manage session shares created by agents in their own spawn subtree. When enabled, agents can also revoke any existing session share, including links created by you, and read the URL of every existing session share, including links created by you or by another agent.
allows_agents_to_create_artifact_shares_: Allows agents to create artifact shares whose target belongs to their own spawn subtree, and to manage artifact shares created by agents in their own spawn subtree. When enabled, agents can also revoke any existing artifact share, including links created by you, and read the URL of every existing artifact share, including links created by you or by another agent.
shown_to_peers_in_your_pairing_requests_: Shown to peers in your pairing requests so they know who is asking. Empty uses your address's hostname.
changing_this_address_disables_active_pe: Changing this address disables active Peer relationships and clears their credentials. You must reconnect each Peer manually.
use_the_external_address_from_general_se: Use the External address from General settings
your_address_advertised_to_peers_empty_d: Your address, advertised to peers. Empty disables peer messaging. A different address from External serves peer traffic only; the same address keeps the whole app reachable there. HTTPS strongly recommended. The host must be reachable machine-to-machine: a tunnel-level access gate (e.g. Cloudflare Access asking for an email or Google account) blocks peer calls — use a truly public hostname.
inactive_if_the_screen_is_too_narrow: Inactive if the screen is too narrow.
show_time_under_each_message_block: Show time under each message block
number_of_sessions_kept_in_memory_for_in: Number of sessions kept in memory for instant switching.
if_the_selected_provider_cannot_be_used_: If the selected provider cannot be used — disabled, over quota, or failing — TwiCC generates the title with the other provider, when that one is enabled.
your_choice_is_kept_and_comes_back_as_so: Your choice is kept, and comes back as soon as you enable its provider again.
as_placeholder_press_apply_to_save: as placeholder. Press Apply to save.
tmux_sessions_are_destroyed_when_their_a: Tmux sessions are destroyed when their agent session is archived.
alerts_you_when_a_provider_starts_consum: Alerts you when a provider starts consuming its extra usage credits again after a quiet period. See the
tab_for_sound_browser_and_pushed_device_: tab for sound, browser and pushed-device options.
press_apply_or_enter_to_validate_and_sav: Press Apply or Enter to validate and save the path.
a_provider_s_5_hour_quota_window_starts_: A provider's 5-hour quota window starts on its first request and resets 5 hours later, so opening it earlier fits more windows into your working day. Pick a time and TwiCC sends a tiny throwaway request at that hour each day to start the window early — skipped if one is already running. It only fires while TwiCC is running at that time (no catch-up if it was off).
if_you_already_maintain_a_json_file_with: If you already maintain a JSON file with usage data outside TwiCC (typically because the provider's API is rate-limited), point to it here and TwiCC will read from this file instead of calling the API directly.
save_the_raw_api_response_to_a_json_file: Save the raw API response to a JSON file each time TwiCC fetches usage data. Useful if you want to share the data with other tools without extra API calls.
sections_and_settings_marked_with_a_clou: Sections and settings marked with a cloud icon are synced across all your devices.
all_with_a_running_process_or_unread_con: All with a running process or unread content
name_your_projects_to_keep_them_at_the_t: Name your projects to keep them at the top of the list. Named projects are always displayed first, making your most important projects easier to find. To name a project, click the
absolute_path_to_the_project_directory: Absolute path to the project directory
name: Name
optional_display_name_max_25_characters_: Optional display name (max 25 characters) — Named projects will always be displayed above unnamed ones.
a_favicon_or_logo_found_in_the_git_repos: A favicon or logo found in the git repository is used automatically. Set your own icon for this project — it applies to its sub-projects too, unless they set their own. “Scan repository…” lists every icon found so you can pick one; “Follow inherited icon” drops this project's own icon and inherits again; “Use color instead” shows the color dot.
no_icons_found_in_this_repository: No icons found in this repository.
absolute_base_directory_where_new_git_wo: Absolute base directory where new git worktrees of this project are created. Leave empty to use the global default.
is_this_a_project_you_created_or_trust_y: Is this a project you created or trust (your own code, a well-known open-source project, or your team's work)? Claude Code and Codex will be able to read, edit and run files here.
no_own_decision_inherits_the_trust_of_a_: No own decision — inherits the trust of a parent project.
not_resolved_you_ll_be_asked_when_starti: Not resolved — you'll be asked when starting a session here.
descendants_inherit_this_decision_until_: — descendants inherit this decision until you decide otherwise.
layout_new_sessions_in_this_project_open: Layout new sessions in this project open with. Inherit = use the parent project's default (for a worktree), then the global default.
urls_saved_for_the_session_browser_tab_t: URLs saved for the session Browser tab; the selected one is the Home default. Empty list = inherit — the parent project's URLs (for a worktree), then a containing workspace's.
all_workspaces_for_this_project_are_arch: All workspaces for this project are archived (hidden).
workspaces_whose_auto_add_pattern_matche: Workspaces whose auto-add pattern matches this directory will be added automatically on creation, even if you remove them here.
this_directory_does_not_exist_do_you_wan: This directory does not exist. Do you want to create it?
workspaces_let_you_group_projects_togeth: Workspaces let you group projects together so you can focus on a subset of your work. Create one with the
no_workspaces_yet_create_one_to_get_star: No workspaces yet. Create one to get started.
all_projects_in_this_workspace_are_archi: All projects in this workspace are archived (hidden).
new_projects_whose_directory_matches_a_p: New projects whose directory matches a pattern will be added automatically when detected.
as_wildcard_a_plain_directory_matches_al: as wildcard. A plain directory matches all projects inside it.
to_add_existing_matching_projects_click: To add existing matching projects, click
urls_saved_for_the_session_browser_tab_o: URLs saved for the session Browser tab of this workspace's projects; the selected one is the Home default. A project's own saved URLs take precedence.
an_error_occurred_while_loading_data: An error occurred while loading data
language_hint: Applies immediately to this browser. Other devices keep their own language.
stop_processes: Stop the process | Stop the processes
failed_to_reset_telemetry_instance_id: Failed to reset telemetry instance ID
session_files_were_deleted_from_disk: Session files were deleted from disk
this_session_runs_in_a_git_worktree: This session runs in a git worktree
interrupt_the_current_turn_keeps_the_ses: Interrupt the current turn (keeps the session alive)
use_a_normal_message_or_clear_your_quest: Use a normal message or clear your question answers before sending a command.
twicc_and_the_provider_do_not_save_a_loc: TwiCC and the provider do not save a local session transcript. Only the final answer appears.
this_browser_saves_your_prompt_and_answe: This browser saves your prompt and answer until Discard. You cannot resume the run. A connection loss can lose its answer.
inherited_mcp_servers_are_off_codex_plug: Inherited MCP servers are off. Codex plugins are also off for this run.
debug_view_forced_for_this_session_click: Debug view forced for this session — click to restore the global mode
force_the_debug_view_for_this_session_on: Force the debug view for this session only
configure_a_share_host_in_settings_shari: Configure a share host in Settings → Sharing to create links
muted_click_to_restore_the_finished_work: Muted — click to restore the "finished working" notification and the unread flag
notifications_on_click_to_silence_the_fi: Notifications on — click to silence the "finished working" notification and stop this session showing as unread
network_error_while_saving_the_icon: Network error while saving the icon.
name_must_be_25_characters_or_less: Name must be 25 characters or less
a_project_with_this_name_already_exists: A project with this name already exists
send_while_working: You can send a message now. {provider} will receive it as soon as possible (while working or after).
share_active_links: Share session ({count} active link) | Share session ({count} active links)
discard_selection: Discard {count} local session? | Discard {count} local sessions?
worktree_template_hint: Template for the base directory of new git worktrees; pre-fills the path when creating one ({relative} allowed). Placeholders: {gitRoot} (the project's git root), {projectName} (its name, or its folder name if unnamed), {projectBasedir} (its folder name). E.g. {exampleRelative} or {exampleAbsolute}. A project can override this with its own absolute directory. Leave empty for no default.
save_layout_hint: Save new layouts from a session: dock some panels, then open the layout menu (the {button} button at the right of the tab bar) and choose “Save layout”.
tmux_config_hint: TwiCC always runs tmux on a dedicated socket per instance and forces {mouseOff} after session creation — these invariants are required for frontend selection and scroll to work. Your config is loaded first (so status bar, colors, bindings apply), then the mouse option is overridden at the session level. Leave empty to ignore any config. Applies to new terminals only.
copy_on_select_hint: When enabled, selecting text in a terminal with the mouse copies it to the clipboard automatically (paste with {shortcut}) — no need to click Copy. The selection stays visible.
clipboard_primary_hint: The text goes to the regular clipboard, not the mouse "primary" selection (middle-click paste): browsers can't write to the primary selection, so middle-click won't paste it.
option_meta_hint: When enabled, Option acts as the Meta key for shell shortcuts ({back}/{forward} to move word by word, {lastArgument} for the last argument), but characters typed with Option — such as {pipe}, {brace} or {backslash} on international keyboard layouts — can no longer be entered. Stored per device; applies to open terminals immediately.
if_the_selected_model_cannot_be_used: If the selected model cannot be used — disabled, over quota, or failing — TwiCC generates the title with another model, when one is available.
your_choice_returns_after_openrouter_set: Your choice is kept, and comes back once the OpenRouter key is set and TwiCC restarted.
five_hour_usage_quota_hint: Depending on your plan, the 5-hour usage quota does not exist. If that applies to you, you can hide it. | Depending on your plans, the 5-hour usage quota does not exist. If that applies to you, you can hide it.
session_history_unavailable_for_sharing: This session's history is not available: it cannot be shared
